title: ALMA Observation of 158 μm [C II] Line and Dust Continuum of a z = 7 Normally Star-forming Galaxy in the Epoch of Reionization
question: What are the [CII] line and FIR dust continuum properties (dust mass, IR luminosity, obscured SFR) of a normal z=6.96 LAE, IOK-1, and how does it compare with other galaxy populations?

data.sensitivity: 215 µJy/beam per 40 km/s channel; 18 µJy/beam continuum (7.5 GHz) at native resolution; 240 and 21 µJy/beam at 1.5"x1.2"

what.value: Local galaxy template SEDs (Arp 220, M82, M51, NGC 6946)

evidence.quote: Arp 220, M82, M51, NGC 6946 (the left panel in Figure [2](#SED_IOK-1)) taken from (cite: Silva98)

what.value: Dwarf/irregular templates and dust temperature/beta (average 27.6 K, beta=1.5)

evidence.loc: 3.1.3 Dust Mass, IR Luminosity and Dust-obscured SFR
evidence.quote: $T_{\rm dust}^{z=0}=27.6$ K and $\beta=1.5$, the average values of 17 local dwarf and irregular galaxies

evidence.loc: 3.1.3 Dust Mass, IR Luminosity and Dust-obscured SFR
evidence.quote: (cite: Jiang13) estimated the SFR of IOK-1 to be SFR$_{\rm UV} \sim 23.9$ $M_{\odot}$yr$^{-1}$

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image continuum and [CII] cubes
recipe.method: CASA reduction, natural weighting, 100 kλ taper to 1.5"x1.2"
Non-detection; 3 sigma upper limits from tapered map rms

recipe.goal: Compare SED with local galaxy templates incl. CMB effects
recipe.method: Shift templates to z=6.96, normalise to F125W, apply CMB heating and background corrections (Eqs. 1-7)
assumptions: Template T_dust and beta from literature (e.g. Arp 220 66.7 K, 1.83)

recipe.goal: Derive dust mass, L_FIR, L_IR, SFR_dust limits
recipe.method: Scale MBB (T=27.6 K, beta=1.5) to CMB-corrected limit; integrate 42.5–122.5 µm and 8–1000 µm; Kennicutt98 SFR
assumptions: Dwarf-galaxy T_dust=27.6 K, beta=1.5; Salpeter IMF; cosmology (0.3,0.7,0.7)

recipe.goal: Place IOK-1 and other LAEs in L_[CII]-SFR and L_[CII]/L_FIR-L_FIR diagrams
recipe.method: Compare limits with literature relations (De Looze11) and populations

evidence.quote: the $3\sigma$ upper limit on [CII] line flux density of IOK-1 is 720 $\mu$Jy beam$^{-1}$ over a channel width of 40 km s$^{-1}$

evidence.loc: 3.1.3 Dust Mass, IR Luminosity and Dust-obscured SFR
3.1.3 Dust Mass, IR Luminosity and Dust-obscured SFR
evidence.quote: $f_{\rm obscured}=$ SFR$_{\rm dust}/$SFR$_{\rm total} < 29$% of star formation is obscured by dust in IOK-1.
the redshift based on its peak is $z_{\rm [CII]}=6.9585$
